hold_text: Venue net P&L sweep starves its own backlog. Observed after the 17:36Z deploy: 8 Bybit rows classified by 17:40Z, then none (no summary lines since 17:40Z), while 87 Bybit rows closed in the last 7 days stay pnl_basis NULL and every tick logs budget_deferred 46. Cause: rows still waiting for their venue record are newest in the scan, so they re-read their (account, symbol, hour) windows every tick and use the whole 4-read budget. Fix: a window read within 10 min is served from the last result (a failed or could_not_look read is never held), so the budget reaches older windows. FEWER venue calls, never a delay on one. Test: test_rows_still_waiting_do_not_starve_the_older_backlog fails on main and passes here; 17/17. Rows age out of Bybit's 7-day closed-pnl retention, so the oldest pending (closed 11-13 06:17Z) has about 5 days. order_monitor.py restarts the trader. Revert: git revert.
why: The venue-P&L sweep stalled after 8 rows; 87 Bybit closes are waiting and will age out of the 7-day window.
